history.rating_rationale: The Tre Ver is a well-regarded UOL riverfront project; the data is the most robust in the batch (295 URA txns) and the $1,717 psf asking sits exactly on the $1,717 median — fair value, no discount. 750m to Potong Pasir NE10 MRT and a new 2023 build are real positives, and the score (708) reflects quality. But the 2.87% CAGR is modest, it is a niche 1BR shoebox at a fair-value entry, and 99LH lease clock is running — steady, not standout. A solid-quality Neutral leaning positive on yield.

history.summary: High-quality 2023 UOL/SingLand riverfront project (WOHA-designed) in D13 with a verified, meaningful value gap: asking $1,717 psf for a 495 sqft 1BR vs recent 1BR transactions of $1,898-$2,061 psf — a real ~10%+ discount.
history.rating_rationale: This is value confirmed by transactions, the strongest forward signal in v3.4. Recent (Dec-2025/Jan-2026) 1BR deals printed $1,898 psf (506 sqft) up to $2,061 psf (689 sqft), and 6-month average is ~$1,971 psf; the median across 402 txns is ~$1,847. The asking $1,717 psf is materially below all of these, validating the algo's -19.2% age-adj cheapness and -6.1% vs-cohort discount — and that signal rests on real depth (295 appreciation txns, 17 cohort txns), not a quirk. Quality is top-tier: UOL Group + Singapore Land JV, WOHA Architects, two Asia-Pacific Property Awards, completed 2023 (fresh leasehold, ~96 years left). D13 (Potong Pasir/Macpherson) is RCR/OCR-adjacent with good central-line access. Confidence is high because both legs — verified cheap-vs-recent-transactions and decisive physical/developer quality — line up; the sub-$850k absolute quantum also aids exit liquidity.
red_flags: Small 495 sqft 1BR — narrowest tenant pool and most exposed to small-unit oversupply
Asking well below recent comps may signal a lower floor or less-preferred (non-river) facing — verify stack/view
Mass 1BR cohort means many competing sellers within the 729-unit project
catalysts: 2023 completion in an established UOL riverfront project still ramping its resale price discovery
Bidadari estate maturation and Woodleigh/Potong Pasir amenity growth nearby supporting D13 demand
Strong rental catchment from central employment nodes via NEL
